title: MultiHurtCam
description: Simple mod for customizing Minecraft's default damage tilt by allowing you to choose what type of damage type you want to see and what you want to disable!
body: 1.21.x fabric mod that allows you to enable and disable specifc damage types, for example putting Repspawn anchor damage at 0% will cause your screen to stay still when exploding one, likewise if I have end crystal explosion at 100% my screen will shake like default minecraft. You can select the type of hurtcam (Yaw-based or Pre 1.19.4).
